features.name: nsw_price_demand_ratio
features.description: Ratio of NSW price to NSW demand, capturing price pressure relative to load.
features.expected_model_benefit: Trees can split on price-per-unit-demand, a strong indicator of supply tightness.

features.name: vic_price_demand_ratio
features.description: Ratio of VIC price to VIC demand, indicating Victoria market tightness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides region-specific supply/demand stress signal for tree splits.

features.name: nsw_vic_price_spread
features.description: Difference between NSW and VIC normalized prices indicating cross-region arbitrage.
features.expected_model_benefit: Price spread sign and magnitude drive transfer flows and directional moves.

features.name: nsw_vic_demand_spread
features.description: Difference between NSW and VIC normalized demand.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures relative load imbalance between regions useful for splits.

features.name: total_demand
features.description: Sum of NSW and VIC demand representing aggregate system load.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregate load level is a key threshold variable for price regimes.

features.name: transfer_deviation_from_neutral
features.description: Absolute deviation of transfer from its neutral midpoint of 0.5.
features.expected_model_benefit: High deviation indicates strong directional inter-regional flow useful for splits.

features.name: period_peak_indicator
features.description: Boolean indicator for peak daytime trading periods (roughly 9am-9pm in normalized period).
features.expected_model_benefit: Peak hours have systematically different price dynamics; clean binary split.

features.name: period_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucket of period into 6 four-hour blocks of the day.
features.expected_model_benefit: Discretized time-of-day enables cleaner categorical-style splits in trees.

features.name: nsw_price_high_flag
features.description: Indicator that NSW price exceeds one standard deviation above mean (>0.10).
features.expected_model_benefit: High-price regime flag offers a clean threshold split for trees.

features.name: transfer_demand_interaction
features.description: Interaction of transfer level with total system demand.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures whether high transfer occurs under high or low demand, useful nonlinearity.

features.name: market_stress_score
features.description: Composite semantic score combining elevated prices, high demand, and extreme transfer indicating stressed market conditions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes multi-signal stress into a single ordinal feature trees can threshold.

features.name: demand_regime_bucket
features.description: Ordinal judgment bucket categorizing the overall demand regime as low, medium, high, or extreme based on combined NSW and VIC demand.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a coarse load-regime split point that trees can exploit alongside finer features.
